title: MCP-Eco: A Linked Dataset of MCP Servers, Consumers, and Development Activity
abstract: arXiv:2611.06897v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables LLM agents to access external tools and data. Studying its software ecosystem requires connecting server interfaces, the projects that configure these servers, and their development activity. However, this information is scattered across directories, package registries, configuration files, and repository histories. We present MCP-Eco, a relational dataset that integrates these sources and links consumer configuration declarations to candidate server projects. Its frozen release contains 16,880,899 records across 19 Parquet tables, covering 78,302 candidate server projects, 16,165 candidate consuming repositories, and 9,200 configuration declarations. Of these declarations, 5,975 resolve to 5,138 distinct repository-server pairs. translated_title: MCP-Eco：MCP服务器、消费者与开发活动的关联数据集
translated_abstract: 模型上下文协议使LLM智能体能够访问外部工具和数据。研究其软件生态系统需要将服务器接口、配置这些服务器的项目及其开发活动关联起来，然而这些信息分散在目录、包注册表、配置文件和代码库历史之中。我们提出了MCP-Eco，一个整合上述来源的关系型数据集，将消费者配置声明与候选服务器项目链接起来。其冻结版本发布包含19个Parquet表中的16,880,899条记录，涵盖78,302个候选服务器项目、16,165个候选消费代码库以及9,200条配置声明。其中5,975条声明解析为5,138对不同的代码库-服务器配对。该数据集还包含工具、资源和提示词描述、声明的依赖关系，以及相关的开发记录，包括拉取请求、代码审查和议题等。
tldr: MCP-Eco是首个整合MCP服务器接口、消费者配置声明与开发活动数据的关系型数据集，包含近1,700万条记录，为系统研究MCP软件生态系统提供了数据基础。
